I am writing to express my interest in the Platform Engineer role at Kingsley Logistics. As a professional who prefers remote-first teams in European time zones, I am particularly drawn to your remote-first culture. My background in TypeScript, Node.js, and infrastructure aligns well with the requirements for Kubernetes, Terraform, and a TypeScript control plane.

In my six years as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, I owned a TypeScript/Node order-routing service handling approximately 2 million events per day, and I have applied Kubernetes and Terraform for service deployment. More recently, as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I led a team of five across dispatch and billing products. I also successfully migrated a monolith to event-driven services with zero customer-visible downtime, reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds.

I am eager to bring my infrastructure and platform engineering experience to Kingsley Logistics. My PostgreSQL skills, including schema design and query tuning, along with the migration experience, position me to contribute to your TypeScript control plane and Kubernetes environments. I look forward to discussing how I can support your remote-first team.
